assessment: All ten measured journeys passed their functional assertions, but the unchanged CPU4x scroll p95 budget of 35.2 ms failed at 180 rows (39.5 ms) and 600 rows (39.8 ms). All other scroll p95 checks, large retained-heap and older-page layout/style p95 limits, visible-anchor limits and ordinary mounted-row limits passed. Functional completion alone is not performance acceptance. Post-scroll settlement costs remain explicit: 600-row accumulated settlement took 1941.0 ms desktop, 2893.7 ms mobile and 6029.6 ms CPU4x, ending with complete readable viewport coverage and zero spacer pixels.
normalization: Per-request ResourceTiming arrays are reduced to request counts, display-source counts, transferred bytes and duration totals. Every measured stage, all eighteen 48-frame scroll arrays, heap counters, settlement observations, screenshot counters and original budget comparisons are retained without changing measured values or acceptance thresholds.

residency.windowRows: Logical paged display window; independent of hydrated data and mounted DOM rows.

cases.cache: Fresh origin/context through accumulated traversal; warm reload before bookmark/jump/stream stages.

fixture.imageLoading: Eager local PNG decoding stress fixture; ordinary parser-default images are lazy.

cases.attribution: Resource durations measure hydration/display-source request delivery. responseEndToSettledMs includes scheduling, parser, mounting and image decoding; it is NOT isolated parser CPU. CDP scriptMs also includes other JavaScript. CDP layout/style are reported independently. Browser polling, CDP sampling, and three settling animation frames are included in stage wall times. Each unchanged 48-frame scroll sweep has a separately measured settlement stage before retained-heap collection, including admission completion, rendered text/images, and visible message coverage. Provider release is manually gated; first-chunk time can include remaining generation preparation after projected-row admission. Actual mounted and logical window counts expose any window reset on send. The cost journey has no continuous DOM observer; separate functional cases check transient row bounds.

workflows.fullDataOnly: Bookmark preparation may hydrate the full transcript while its chat-list route has no transcript DOM; export/tokenization similarly need data, not necessarily DOM.
workflows.screenshot: Explicit temporary full materialization, outside the interactive residency envelope; measured by the separate screenshot case and restored to the prior window.
